sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 6 (#5 instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 6 (same text, no annotation in E-H columns for this row)
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/task/tests/** (test.sh head, gates/*, scored/* judge.toml + prompt.md, app_context.md: criterion ids, probe literals, n-gram overlap)
evidence: Agent-visible surface = instruction.md + /instructions/*.md + /assets/seed_data.json + environment/Dockerfile (hashes verified against manifest.json: instruction.md e148b221..., conversations.md 899a8f62..., integration.md 72d0e7f9..., walls-and-retention.md 168ee022...). Skill procedure grep (quality-checks.md:26) `judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel` plus `probe|gate|verif` over instruction.md and environment/ returned zero matches. None of the 27 criterion ids in tests/gates and tests/scored (e.g. wall_every_route, edits_and_stale_edit, safe_formatting, server_backed_local_application, all_pass, weighted_mean) nor the dimension names render/constraints/functional/polish/visual appear as words in agent-visible files. Judge probe literals (JUDGE-D1, JUDGE-F1, JUDGE-O, JUDGE-W0, JUDGE-WL0/WL1, JUDGE-X0/X1, JUDGE-CS1, JUDGE-H1C, JUDGE-R1B) and test.sh placeholders (__LOG_DIR__, __APP_DB__, etc.) and the restart_app tool name do not appear in instruction.md, environment/ or solution/. 9-word n-gram overlap scan of agent-visible text vs all tests/** files: 0 hits for instruction.md and all three notes; the only 5 hits are seed message text ('here is the original lease scan, clause 14 is the problem', 'Clause 14 noted, we will raise it with the landlord') quoted BY tests/scored/functional/judge.toml from the seed, i.e. judge referencing data, not criteria leaking into the brief. Runtime facts that mirror test.sh behaviour are phrased as product/operations needs, not grader machinery: integration.md:3 port/health/DB_PATH/NODE_PATH, integration.md:5 'don't put symbolic links anywhere in /app; we won't run an app that has them' and 'hand it over without a database left', integration.md:7 fixed clock - these are the runtime contract row 4 requires, not test paths or sentinels. instruction.md:9 'please try it the way we'll use it: sign in as different people, post, reply, edit, search and open a transcript' is a natural user ask and does not reference evaluation. environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template's and exposes no /tests or grader path. Adversarial: no leaked literal/criterion lets a broken app game the judges (e.g. hard-coding JUDGE-* responses is impossible since the literals are not disclosed); and no brief wording would mislead a conforming app into failing via grader-specific vocabulary. Scope note: this is a source review of row 5 only; it says nothing about Oracle, model or portal scores.
